memo.headline: Focus on improving playback issues to maintain user satisfaction and reduce churn
memo.rationale: The playback issue has the highest priority score (43467) and is ranked first. Reviews like review_id=00d770d6-fdc3-4521-8cce-1a9613b9cadd and review_id=07f59bbd-a997-47f6-b91e-4a9a5c645c32 highlight severe issues with the app's functionality, leading to app force closes and data loss. (C1, C2)

alternatives.why_not: While usability issues are also critical, the playback issues are currently more pressing due to their severity and the specific functional failures reported by users.

memo.limitations: The review data is self-selected and may not represent the full user base. Users have expressed intent to churn but have not yet done so, and the data is based on partial months.
